pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal to sub-rectangular dark regions with soft, blurred edge gradients. Spatial area of patches is largest on the central flank, transitioning to smaller, more compressed geometric forms toward the lower neck and shoulder regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored corridors forming a grid-like topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Corridor thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-section, characterized by low-contrast transitions into the patch regions.
